column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 23 (E99013): Tokarev menghidupkan frekuensi lama Griffin dan
# menggelar pertemuan pertama Griffin Alumni Association; Lee-Enfield menolak jadi ketua.
# Tetap Inggris: Tokarev, Helian, Griffin, URNC, Commander, Kalina, Springfield, AA-12,
# Lind, Lee-Enfield, Green Zone, Yellow Zone, Doll, neural cloud, Griffin Alumni Association.

(Near the border of the Green Zone and the Yellow Zone, a faint smell of rosin mixed with machine oil floated in the hidden safehouse Tokarev had just purchased. In the dim room, only the indicator lights of a few modified precision instruments flickered silently.)
column2: (Di dekat perbatasan Green Zone dan Yellow Zone, bau samar damar bercampur oli mesin mengapung di safehouse tersembunyi yang baru dibeli Tokarev. Di ruangan yang remang itu, hanya lampu indikator beberapa instrumen presisi hasil modifikasi yang berkelip tanpa suara.)

column1: (Tokarev sat at the workbench, carefully looking at the hard-won military-grade communication device in front of her. Her fingers gently stroked the cold metal casing, her neural modules running at high speed, earnestly recalling the complex and even somewhat rule-breaking technical points regarding such equipment that Helian had instructed her on.)
column2: (Tokarev duduk di meja kerja, menatap dengan teliti perangkat komunikasi kelas militer di depannya yang didapat dengan susah payah. Jarinya mengusap lembut badan logam yang dingin itu, modul neuralnya berjalan kencang, sungguh-sungguh mengingat poin teknis yang rumit dan bahkan agak melanggar aturan yang dulu diajarkan Helian soal perangkat semacam itu.)

column1: (After all, if anything went wrong with this, she really wouldn't be able to explain it to Miss Helian.)
column2: (Lagi pula kalau ada yang salah dengan ini, dia benar-benar tidak akan bisa menjelaskannya pada Miss Helian.)

column1: I understand your request, Tokarev.
column2: Aku paham permintaanmu, Tokarev.

column1: You want to buy communication equipment phased out by Griffin, but you don't seem interested in the equipment itself—what you want to recover is the frequency band data in the equipment's memory that hasn't been completely erased, right?
column2: Kau ingin membeli perangkat komunikasi yang dipensiunkan Griffin, tapi kau sepertinya tidak tertarik pada perangkatnya sendiri—yang ingin kau pulihkan adalah data pita frekuensi di memori perangkat itu yang belum terhapus sepenuhnya, kan?

column1: You want to reactivate the old Griffin frequencies to contact everyone scattered across the world.
column2: Kau ingin menghidupkan kembali frekuensi lama Griffin untuk menghubungi semua orang yang tersebar di seluruh dunia.

column1: (Ten minutes ago, Tokarev came to Helian's office and submitted a written request to purchase Griffin communication equipment.)
column2: (Sepuluh menit sebelumnya, Tokarev datang ke kantor Helian dan mengajukan permohonan tertulis untuk membeli perangkat komunikasi Griffin.)

column1: (But this matter seems to be a bit trickier than Tokarev anticipated.)
column2: (Tapi urusan ini sepertinya lebih rumit dari yang diperkirakan Tokarev.)

column1: ...Yes, you're right.
column2: ...Ya, kau benar.

column1: (Helian expressionlessly takes Tokarev's written agreement and then feeds it into the paper shredder right in front of her—)
column2: (Tanpa ekspresi Helian mengambil perjanjian tertulis Tokarev lalu memasukkannya ke penghancur kertas tepat di depannya—)

column1: From an official standpoint—the disposal of Griffin's assets requires review by the URNC, and they are absolutely not allowed to flow to unqualified secondary contractors or individuals.
column2: Dari sudut pandang resmi—pelepasan aset Griffin harus melalui peninjauan URNC, dan sama sekali tidak boleh mengalir ke kontraktor sekunder atau perorangan yang tidak memenuhi syarat.

column1: Submitting this application to the higher-ups will immediately put you on a key watch list, and those Dolls who have already left Griffin will be heavily monitored by local URNC governments.
column2: Mengajukan permohonan ini ke atas akan langsung menempatkanmu di daftar pengawasan utama, dan para Doll yang sudah meninggalkan Griffin akan diawasi ketat oleh pemerintah URNC setempat.

column1: ...I'm sorry! I didn't expect the consequences to be so severe! I thought about things too simply.
column2: ...Maafkan aku! Aku tidak menyangka akibatnya seberat itu! Aku memikirkannya terlalu sederhana.

column1: Miss Helian, I was too reckless and caused you trouble.
column2: Miss Helian, aku terlalu gegabah dan menyusahkanmu.

column1: (Tokarev bowed in shame.)
column2: (Tokarev membungkuk dengan malu.)

column1: Raise your head first, Tokarev.
column2: Angkat kepalamu dulu, Tokarev.

column1: (Helian sighed. She walked to the window and pulled the blinds shut, completely blocking the view from the corridor outside, and the light in the office dimmed.)
column2: (Helian mengembuskan napas. Dia melangkah ke jendela dan menutup kerainya, sepenuhnya memblokir pandangan dari koridor di luar, dan cahaya di kantor itu meredup.)

column1: I've said all I need to say on the surface. What comes next doesn't belong to any work category.
column2: Yang perlu kukatakan secara permukaan sudah kukatakan semua. Yang berikutnya tidak masuk kategori pekerjaan apa pun.

column1: Just listen casually. After leaving this room, I won't admit I ever said it.
column2: Dengarkan santai saja. Setelah keluar dari ruangan ini, aku tidak akan mengakui pernah mengatakannya.

column1: ...Oh! Okay!
column2: ...Oh! Baik!

column1: Griffin is currently undergoing reorganization. With limited funds, they indeed need to sell off a large amount of assets.
column2: Griffin sekarang sedang ditata ulang. Dengan dana yang terbatas, mereka memang harus menjual banyak aset.

column1: The URNC is keeping a close eye on things. Any procedures will go through strict scrutiny, and no one can escape it.
column2: URNC mengawasi dengan ketat. Prosedur apa pun akan melalui pemeriksaan ketat, dan tidak ada yang bisa lolos.

column1: The above statement has a prerequisite—it applies to assets that are explicitly registered and confirmed to be held.
column2: Pernyataan di atas punya syarat—itu berlaku untuk aset yang tercatat jelas dan dipastikan dimiliki.

column1: You also know that Griffin has suffered quite a bit over the years. After fighting for so many years, a massive amount of equipment has accumulated in the warehouses...
column2: Kau juga tahu Griffin sudah cukup babak belur bertahun-tahun ini. Setelah bertempur bertahun-tahun, perlengkapan dalam jumlah masif menumpuk di gudang...

column1: How much of this equipment has an "unknown whereabouts", how much was "accidentally" destroyed by artillery fire, and how much was registered as "unusable junk assets" for inexplicable reasons...
column2: Berapa banyak perlengkapan itu yang "tidak diketahui keberadaannya", berapa yang "tidak sengaja" hancur oleh tembakan artileri, dan berapa yang tercatat sebagai "aset rongsok tak terpakai" karena alasan yang tak bisa dijelaskan...

column1: Who can say for sure? At least I can't.
column2: Siapa yang bisa memastikan? Setidaknya aku tidak bisa.

column1: (Helian revealed a faint smile.)
column2: (Helian menampakkan senyum samar.)

column1: I understand! Miss Helian!
column2: Aku paham! Miss Helian!

column1: (Helian made a 'shh' gesture to her, then pointed somewhat helplessly at the paper shredder.)
column2: (Helian membuat gestur 'ssst' padanya, lalu menunjuk penghancur kertas itu dengan agak tak berdaya.)

column1: Don't leave any traces of this kind of thing in the future, understand? Even I don't know how many pairs of URNC eyes are watching us.
column2: Ke depan jangan meninggalkan jejak untuk hal seperti ini, paham? Bahkan aku tidak tahu berapa pasang mata URNC yang mengawasi kita.

column1: Go ahead and do what you want to do, Tokarev. If the Commander you've always followed were here, he would definitely support you in doing this too.
column2: Lakukan saja apa yang ingin kau lakukan, Tokarev. Kalau Commander yang selama ini kau ikuti ada di sini, dia pasti juga mendukungmu melakukannya.

column1: You are a smart child, you know how to hide in the dark and protect yourself.
column2: Kau anak yang pintar, kau tahu cara bersembunyi di kegelapan dan melindungi dirimu.

column1: Of course, if you encounter any unsolvable danger outside... remember to contact me or Kalina at any time.
column2: Tentu, kalau kau menemui bahaya yang tak terpecahkan di luar sana... ingat hubungi aku atau Kalina kapan saja.

column1: Understood! Miss Helian!
column2: Dimengerti! Miss Helian!

column1: Thank you for your guidance!
column2: Terima kasih atas bimbinganmu!

column1: (Tokarev took a deep breath, pulling her thoughts back to reality. Following the method Helian had hinted at, she repeatedly checked the communication device in front of her that had undergone 'physical scrapping'. After ensuring all hardware connections were correct, she solemnly pressed the power switch.)
column2: (Tokarev menarik napas panjang, menarik pikirannya kembali ke kenyataan. Mengikuti cara yang disiratkan Helian, dia berkali-kali memeriksa perangkat komunikasi di depannya yang sudah melewati 'penghancuran fisik'. Setelah memastikan semua sambungan perangkat kerasnya benar, dia menekan sakelar dayanya dengan khidmat.)

column1: ...Hmm, if I remember correctly, I should first go through these springboard nodes to forcefully connect to those old frequency bands Griffin used to use...
column2: ...Hmm, kalau tidak salah ingat, aku harus lewat node batu pijakan ini dulu untuk memaksa tersambung ke pita frekuensi lama yang dulu dipakai Griffin...

column1: Then inject the double-layer encrypted communication protocol, set up a dynamic IP address to prevent reverse tracking...
column2: Lalu menyuntikkan protokol komunikasi terenkripsi dua lapis, memasang alamat IP dinamis untuk mencegah pelacakan balik...

column1: Finally, transmit the handshake protocol and wait for a response...
column2: Terakhir, mengirimkan protokol jabat tangan lalu menunggu jawaban...

column1: (The indicator lights jumped rapidly above the keyboard. After a while, as a line of green 'Connected' text popped up on the screen, an uncontrollable joy finally erupted in Tokarev's eyes.)
column2: (Lampu indikator melompat-lompat cepat di atas papan ketik. Beberapa saat kemudian, saat satu baris teks hijau 'Connected' muncul di layar, kegembiraan yang tak tertahan akhirnya meletus di mata Tokarev.)

column1: (After several consecutive all-nighters of repeated debugging and cracking, this old equipment could finally operate officially. Although to ensure absolute secrecy, the signal needed to pass through countless zombie nodes around the world as springboards, resulting in a very slow connection speed.)
column2: (Setelah beberapa malam berturut-turut tanpa tidur untuk terus menelusuri kesalahan dan membongkarnya, perangkat tua itu akhirnya bisa beroperasi resmi. Meski demi kerahasiaan mutlak, sinyalnya harus melewati node zombi tak terhitung di seluruh dunia sebagai batu pijakan, sehingga kecepatan sambungannya sangat lambat.)

column1: (But, as long as they were Dolls who once belonged to Griffin, as long as they still retained their past memories, they would definitely be able to receive and connect to this hidden frequency!)
column2: (Tapi selama mereka Doll yang pernah menjadi bagian Griffin, selama mereka masih menyimpan ingatan masa lalunya, mereka pasti bisa menerima dan tersambung ke frekuensi tersembunyi itu!)

column1: 搞定了！
column2: Beres!

column1: I have to notify everyone quickly, today is...
column2: Aku harus cepat memberi tahu semuanya, hari ini adalah...

column1: (Tokarev glanced at the calendar, barely able to contain her joy and excitement.)
column2: (Tokarev melirik kalender, nyaris tidak sanggup menahan kegembiraan dan semangatnya.)

column1: Today is the first official exchange of the 'Griffin Alumni Association'!
column2: Hari ini pertemuan resmi pertama 'Griffin Alumni Association'!

column1: (The clock on the wall ticked away the seconds, and the agreed time finally arrived.)
column2: (Jam di dinding mendetakkan detiknya, dan waktu yang disepakati akhirnya tiba.)

column1: (This was the day Tokarev had agreed upon after asking Miss Springfield to pass on the message a few days ago.)
column2: (Itu hari yang disepakati Tokarev setelah beberapa hari lalu meminta Miss Springfield menyampaikan pesannya.)

column1: (Although due to the restrictions of the agreement, everyone has long since gone their separate ways, scattered far and wide. Even Springfield, who has the widest network of contacts, cannot quickly contact everyone in a short amount of time...)
column2: (Meski karena batasan perjanjian itu semuanya sudah lama berpisah jalan, tersebar jauh. Bahkan Springfield yang jaringan kontaknya paling luas pun tidak bisa cepat menghubungi semua orang dalam waktu singkat...)

column1: (But, even if I can only connect with 10 people... no, even if only Springfield can come online today, that would be good.)
column2: (Tapi meski aku hanya bisa tersambung dengan 10 orang... bukan, meski hari ini hanya Springfield yang bisa online, itu sudah bagus.)

column1: (As long as I can hear everyone's voices, as long as I can confirm that everyone is still alive and safe in this world...)
column2: (Selama aku bisa mendengar suara semuanya, selama aku bisa memastikan semuanya masih hidup dan aman di dunia ini...)

column1: Everyone, can you hear me?
column2: Semuanya, kedengaran tidak?

column1: (In the silent electronic channel, Tokarev's voice is the first to sound.)
column2: (Di saluran elektronik yang sunyi itu, suara Tokarev yang pertama berbunyi.)

column1: (However, several minutes pass, and not a single person responds to her...)
column2: (Namun beberapa menit berlalu, dan tidak satu orang pun menjawabnya...)

column1: What's going on...?
column2: Ada apa ini...?

column1: Didn't everyone receive the news?
column2: Semuanya tidak menerima kabarnya?

column1: Um... can anyone hear me?
column2: Emm... ada yang bisa mendengarku?

column1: Could there be a problem with the equipment? That's impossible, I just checked it.
column2: Apa ada masalah dengan perangkatnya? Mustahil, aku baru memeriksanya.

column1: I'll reboot and check!
column2: Akan kureboot dan kuperiksa!

column1: (The excitement that had just surged in her neural cloud vanished instantly. Tokarev frowned, unsure for a moment what went wrong.)
column2: (Semangat yang baru meluap di neural cloud-nya hilang seketika. Tokarev mengerutkan dahi, sesaat tidak yakin apa yang salah.)

column1: (She decided to troubleshoot the fault again, so her finger reached for the power button of the communication device.)
column2: (Dia memutuskan menelusuri kesalahannya lagi, jadi jarinya terulur ke tombol daya perangkat komunikasi itu.)

column1: (However, just as she was about to press it, a calm, elegant voice slowly rang out on the channel.)
column2: (Namun tepat saat dia hendak menekannya, sebuah suara yang tenang dan elegan perlahan berbunyi di saluran itu.)

column1: Miss Tokarev, please stay calm.
column2: Miss Tokarev, tolong tetap tenang.

column1: Huh?
column2: Hah?

column1: (Immediately after, a second Doll's voice sounds.)
column2: (Sesaat kemudian, suara Doll kedua berbunyi.)

column1: Ooooh! I'm in, I'm in!
column2: Ooooh! Aku masuk, aku masuk!

column1: Lind, you guys come take a look too.
column2: Lind, kalian juga sini lihat.

column1: Yes, yes, I hear it.
column2: Iya, iya, aku dengar.

column1: It's quite stable... I'm impressed you managed to pick this channel out of Griffin's many silent frequencies. It's been dormant since before some Dolls even joined Griffin, and the multiple encryption algorithms you set up are well hidden.
column2: Cukup stabil... Aku terkesan kau bisa memilih saluran ini dari sekian banyak frekuensi Griffin yang bisu. Frekuensi ini tidur bahkan sebelum sebagian Doll bergabung ke Griffin, dan algoritma enkripsi berlapis yang kau pasang tersembunyi dengan baik.

column1: But to complete the handshake protocol without triggering the local security bureau's alarms, you have to give everyone a little time to decode and confirm, right?
column2: Tapi untuk menuntaskan protokol jabat tangannya tanpa memicu alarm biro keamanan setempat, kau harus memberi semua orang sedikit waktu untuk memecahkan dan memastikannya, kan?

column1: Still, the signal is stable. Good job.
column2: Meski begitu, sinyalnya stabil. Kerja bagus.

column1: Miss AA-12, ah, or is it better to call you Miss Lind?
column2: Miss AA-12, ah, atau lebih baik memanggilmu Miss Lind?

column1: ...Either is fine. Both names are me.
column2: ...Terserah. Kedua nama itu aku.

column1: Hehe, everyone is as energetic as before.
column2: Hehe, semuanya sesemangat dulu.

column1: Good evening, Tokarev. I spent a little effort on my end to avoid conventional monitoring methods.
column2: Selamat malam, Tokarev. Aku mengeluarkan sedikit usaha di pihakku untuk menghindari metode pengawasan konvensional.

column1: 97, have you been completing your tasks properly lately?
column2: 97, belakangan ini kau menyelesaikan tugasmu dengan benar?

column1: Uweh?! S-Sis...
column2: Ueh?! K-Kak...

column1: (More and more Dolls joined the frequency band, and the originally dead silent channel suddenly boiled over in the next second.)
column2: (Makin banyak Doll bergabung ke pita frekuensi itu, dan saluran yang semula sunyi mati itu mendadak mendidih sedetik kemudian.)

column1: Hello, hello? What kind of last-century latency is this? I almost thought I connected to some alien dial-up network just now!
column2: Halo, halo? Latensi abad lalu macam apa ini? Tadi aku hampir mengira aku tersambung ke jaringan dial-up alien!

column1: But... my god, the springboard setup for this node is pretty good! Tokarev, you actually managed to bypass the Green Zone's network firewall!
column2: Tapi... astaga, susunan batu pijakan node ini lumayan bagus! Tokarev, kau ternyata berhasil melewati firewall jaringan Green Zone!

column1: So cool! Quick, give me admin privileges!
column2: Keren! Cepat, beri aku hak akses admin!

column1: By the way, can this thing be livestreamed? No wait, with this speed, wouldn't the stream latency go through the roof?!
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, benda ini bisa disiarkan langsung? Eh tunggu, dengan kecepatan segini, latensi siarannya bakal meledak dong?!

column1: But that's actually a good idea...
column2: Tapi itu sebenarnya ide yang bagus...

column1: So noisy! My auditory modules are going to overload from your yelling!
column2: Berisik sekali! Modul pendengaranku bisa kelebihan beban gara-gara teriakanmu!

column1: ...Ahem, Tokarev, don't misunderstand. I was just maintaining my equipment and happened to open this channel. I'm actually not bored at all...
column2: ...Ehem, Tokarev, jangan salah paham. Aku cuma sedang merawat perangkatku dan kebetulan membuka saluran ini. Sebenarnya aku sama sekali tidak bosan...

column1: Well, hearing everyone's voices isn't bad.
column2: Yah, mendengar suara semuanya tidak buruk juga.

column1: (Listening to the chaotic complaints, greetings, and bickering in the channel, Tokarev's eyes uncontrollably well up with tears.)
column2: (Mendengar keluhan, sapaan, dan cekcok yang kacau di saluran itu, mata Tokarev berkaca-kaca tanpa bisa ditahan.)

column1: (Even if they can't meet offline, that familiar tone and the messy yet warm background noise instantly pull her back to that Griffin lounge forever filled with the aroma of coffee.)
column2: (Meski mereka tidak bisa bertemu langsung, nada yang dia kenal dan derau latar yang berantakan tapi hangat itu seketika menariknya kembali ke ruang santai Griffin yang selamanya dipenuhi aroma kopi.)

column1: Good evening, Tokarev. Good evening, everyone.
column2: Selamat malam, Tokarev. Selamat malam, semuanya.

column1: I'm very sorry, due to the rush and for safety reasons, I only had time to contact this many companions this time. But I believe that as time goes on and our intelligence network expands, more and more companions will definitely return to the frequency of our big family.
column2: Maafkan aku, karena terburu-buru dan demi keamanan, kali ini aku hanya sempat menghubungi sebanyak ini rekan. Tapi aku percaya seiring waktu dan meluasnya jaringan intel kita, makin banyak rekan pasti akan kembali ke frekuensi keluarga besar kita.

column1: Thank you, Tokarev. Thank you for working so hard to bring us back together.
column2: Terima kasih, Tokarev. Terima kasih sudah bekerja sekeras itu untuk mengumpulkan kami kembali.

column1: Everyone... Miss Springfield... I...
column2: Semuanya... Miss Springfield... aku...

column1: (Tokarev covered her mouth tightly, desperately trying not to let out a sobbing sound on the channel.)
column2: (Tokarev menutup mulutnya rapat-rapat, mati-matian menahan agar isakannya tidak terdengar di saluran itu.)

column1: (The grievances and exhaustion of running around and working day and night to earn money over the past few months all vanished the moment she heard everyone's voices. All the effort was worth it.)
column2: (Segala keluh dan kelelahan karena berlarian dan bekerja siang malam mencari uang beberapa bulan ini hilang begitu dia mendengar suara semuanya. Semua usahanya sepadan.)

column1: It seems all the founding members of the first 'Griffin Alumni Association' have arrived.
column2: Sepertinya semua anggota pendiri 'Griffin Alumni Association' yang pertama sudah datang.

column1: For everyone to successfully connect in such a complex environment, and even perfectly evade the URNC's strictest information screening, this can definitely not be summarized by the simple word 'luck'.
column2: Semua orang bisa tersambung dengan sukses di lingkungan serumit ini, bahkan menghindari penyaringan informasi paling ketat URNC dengan sempurna, itu jelas tidak bisa diringkas dengan kata sederhana 'keberuntungan'.

column1: You did an excellent job, Miss Tokarev.
column2: Kau melakukannya dengan sangat baik, Miss Tokarev.

column1: You proved to us with practical actions that as long as everyone's hearts are still tightly connected, there is no high wall in this world that can truly cut off Griffin's connection.
column2: Kau membuktikan kepada kami lewat tindakan nyata bahwa selama hati semua orang masih tersambung erat, tidak ada tembok setinggi apa pun di dunia ini yang benar-benar bisa memutus ikatan Griffin.

column1: Everyone... welcome back!
column2: Semuanya... selamat datang kembali!

column1: (As the night deepened, the first official contact of the Griffin Alumni Association came to a highly successful end amidst reluctance to part.)
column2: (Saat malam kian larut, kontak resmi pertama Griffin Alumni Association berakhir dengan sangat sukses di tengah keengganan berpisah.)

column1: (During the hours-long channel communication, everyone chatted very happily. Sharing their experiences in different areas, complaining about their bizarre encounters, it was as if they had never been separated, and everything was exactly the same as before.)
column2: (Selama berjam-jam komunikasi di saluran itu, semuanya mengobrol dengan sangat senang. Berbagi pengalaman di area masing-masing, mengeluhkan perjumpaan-perjumpaan ganjil mereka, seolah mereka tidak pernah terpisah, dan semuanya sama persis seperti dulu.)

column1: (The only pity was that they couldn't hear the Commander's voice tonight.)
column2: (Satu-satunya yang disayangkan adalah mereka tidak bisa mendengar suara Commander malam itu.)

column1: That was a really fun chat. Everyone has changed so much...
column2: Obrolan tadi benar-benar seru. Semuanya sudah banyak berubah...

column1: Now that the equipment issue is sorted out, the Griffin Alumni Association can finally start operating for real.
column2: Karena masalah perangkatnya sudah beres, Griffin Alumni Association akhirnya bisa mulai beroperasi sungguhan.

column1: That's really great...
column2: Itu benar-benar bagus...

column1: (Just as Tokarev was savoring the afterglow of their time together, she suddenly thought of something.)
column2: (Tepat saat Tokarev menikmati sisa kehangatan kebersamaan itu, dia tiba-tiba teringat sesuatu.)

column1: Wait... I was too absorbed in catching up with everyone just now, I forgot the main business!
column2: Tunggu... tadi aku terlalu asyik bernostalgia dengan semuanya, sampai lupa urusan utamanya!

column1: The person in charge of the Griffin Alumni Association hasn't been finalized yet?!
column2: Penanggung jawab Griffin Alumni Association belum ditetapkan?!

column1: (Suddenly jolted awake, Tokarev immediately reopened the communication device. However, it was already late at night, and everyone had disconnected and gone offline for safety reasons. In the empty channel, she was the only Doll left online...)
column2: (Tersentak sadar, Tokarev langsung membuka kembali perangkat komunikasinya. Namun malam sudah larut, dan semuanya sudah memutus sambungan dan offline demi keamanan. Di saluran yang kosong itu, hanya dia satu-satunya Doll yang masih online...)

column1: (It seems this topic can only be opened next time.)
column2: (Sepertinya topik itu baru bisa dibuka lain kali.)

column1: (Just as Tokarev was about to turn off the communication device, she recalled the proposal that had been settling in her neural cloud before she dialed the frequency.)
column2: (Tepat saat Tokarev hendak mematikan perangkat komunikasinya, dia teringat usulan yang sudah mengendap di neural cloud-nya sebelum dia memanggil frekuensi itu.)

column1: (She fell into deep thought.)
column2: (Dia tenggelam dalam pikirannya.)

column1: Although I could talk about it next time, I feel like I could also give a heads-up in advance...
column2: Meski bisa dibicarakan lain kali, kurasa aku juga bisa memberi kabar lebih dulu...

column1: Hmm... it's better not to announce this suddenly!
column2: Hmm... lebih baik ini tidak diumumkan mendadak!

column1: (Thinking this, she dialed Lee-Enfield's communication.)
column2: (Berpikir begitu, dia memanggil komunikasi Lee-Enfield.)

column1: I'm really sorry, Miss Lee, for disturbing you so late.
column2: Maafkan aku, Miss Lee, sudah mengganggu selarut ini.

column1: It's fine, I don't have anything urgent.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, aku tidak ada urusan mendesak.

column1: Is there something you need me for?
column2: Ada yang kau butuhkan dariku?

column1: To be honest, there is indeed something I'd like to trouble you with, Miss Lee...
column2: Sejujurnya memang ada hal yang ingin kutitipkan padamu, Miss Lee...

column1: Please speak.
column2: Silakan bicara.

column1: (Tokarev bites her lip. She glances at the communication device placed in the corner, then, as if gathering her courage, speaks to Miss Lee.)
column2: (Tokarev menggigit bibirnya. Dia melirik perangkat komunikasi yang diletakkan di sudut, lalu seolah mengumpulkan keberanian, bicara pada Miss Lee.)

column1: Thanks to your valuable advice earlier, everyone was able to gather together at the Griffin alumni association.
column2: Berkat saranmu yang berharga tempo hari, semuanya bisa berkumpul di griffin alumni association.

column1: But the Griffin Alumni Association is currently missing a person in charge...
column2: Tapi Griffin Alumni Association sekarang belum punya penanggung jawab...

column1: I think Miss Tokarev would be a perfect fit. The fact that everyone can talk like this today is entirely thanks to you.
column2: Kurasa Miss Tokarev sangat cocok. Semua orang bisa berbicara seperti hari ini sepenuhnya berkat kau.

column1: (Hearing this, Tokarev quickly waved her hands and shook her head.)
column2: (Mendengar itu, Tokarev cepat mengibaskan tangan dan menggeleng.)

column1: No, no, no, I just found the communication equipment, anyone could have done that.
column2: Tidak, tidak, tidak, aku cuma menemukan perangkat komunikasinya, siapa pun bisa melakukan itu.

column1: ...The matter of the Griffin Alumni Association should have been spearheaded by someone more professional in the first place.
column2: ...Urusan Griffin Alumni Association sejak awal seharusnya dipimpin orang yang lebih profesional.

column1: It was already very inappropriate of me to act so rashly.
column2: Aku bertindak segegabah itu saja sudah sangat tidak pantas.

column1: (Lee-Enfield uncharacteristically falls into a long silence. Only the faint sound of static rustles in the communication channel, and this unusual quiet makes Tokarev feel somewhat at a loss.)
column2: (Tidak seperti biasanya, Lee-Enfield terdiam lama. Hanya derau samar berdesir di saluran komunikasi, dan kesunyian yang ganjil itu membuat Tokarev agak bingung.)

column1: (But she still mustered her courage and continued to express her thoughts.)
column2: (Tapi dia tetap mengumpulkan keberaniannya dan melanjutkan menyampaikan pikirannya.)

column1: So, I sincerely hope that you can serve as the first person in charge of the Griffin Alumni Association!
column2: Jadi, aku sungguh berharap kau bersedia menjadi penanggung jawab pertama Griffin Alumni Association!

column1: This idea was originally proposed by you as well. You are the most suitable candidate to coordinate everything for the Griffin Alumni Association!
column2: Gagasan ini juga semula kau yang mengusulkannya. Kau kandidat paling cocok untuk mengoordinasikan segalanya di Griffin Alumni Association!

column1: (Another unnerving silence follows.)
column2: (Kesunyian yang membuat gelisah kembali datang.)

column1: Since you have put it that way, Miss Tokarev, my official reply to you is...
column2: Karena kau mengatakannya begitu, Miss Tokarev, jawaban resmiku untukmu adalah...

column1: (On the other end of the comms, Lee-Enfield seems to let out a very soft, gentle chuckle.)
column2: (Di ujung lain komunikasi itu, Lee-Enfield sepertinya melepas kekehan yang sangat lirih dan lembut.)

column1: (Through the screen, Tokarev can almost clearly see the gentleness and immense tolerance on the other's face, carrying the air of British nobility.)
column2: (Lewat layar, Tokarev nyaris bisa melihat jelas kelembutan dan kemakluman besar di wajah lawan bicaranya, yang membawa aura bangsawan Inggris.)

column1: (For a moment, Tokarev feels that her decision couldn't be better; it is absolutely the most appropriate and perfect choice for the current situation.)
column2: (Sesaat Tokarev merasa keputusannya tidak bisa lebih baik lagi; itu jelas pilihan paling pantas dan sempurna untuk situasi sekarang.)

column1: (In Tokarev's expectant heart, Lee-Enfield would definitely agree and take on this heavy burden for the sake of everyone's big picture.)
column2: (Di hati Tokarev yang penuh harap, Lee-Enfield pasti akan setuju dan memikul beban berat itu demi kepentingan semua orang.)

column1: Allow me to refuse.
column2: Izinkan aku menolak.

column1: Are you surprised?
column2: Kau kaget?

column1: If the Commander were standing here right now and heard your statement, he would definitely agree with the decision I'm making at this moment without hesitation.
column2: Kalau Commander berdiri di sini sekarang dan mendengar pernyataanmu, dia pasti akan menyetujui keputusan yang kuambil saat ini tanpa ragu.

column1: Miss Tokarev, please face yourself properly. You are by no means as 'mediocre' as you casually describe yourself. On this point, I can assure you with my honor.
column2: Miss Tokarev, tolong hadapi dirimu sendiri dengan benar. Kau sama sekali tidak 'biasa-biasa saja' seperti yang kau gambarkan sekenanya. Soal itu, aku bisa menjaminnya dengan kehormatanku.

column1: Now, you have single-handedly gathered the scattered sparks back together. This means that the seed the Commander sowed in your neural cloud back then has taken root and sprouted, ultimately bearing rich fruit.
column2: Sekarang kau seorang diri mengumpulkan kembali percikan-percikan yang tersebar. Itu berarti benih yang dulu ditanam Commander di neural cloud-mu sudah berakar dan bertunas, dan akhirnya berbuah lebat.

column1: This is your trial, and also your honor. So I have no reason, let alone the qualification, to overstep my bounds and deprive you of your achievements and responsibilities.
column2: Ini ujianmu, sekaligus kehormatanmu. Jadi aku tidak punya alasan, apalagi kelayakan, untuk melangkahi batas dan merampas pencapaian serta tanggung jawabmu.

column1: Can I... can I really do it?
column2: Apa aku... apa aku benar-benar bisa?

column1: Even if your neural cloud is full of self-doubt right now, even if you haven't clearly felt that leader's power yet, it doesn't matter.
column2: Meski neural cloud-mu sekarang penuh keraguan pada diri sendiri, meski kau belum jelas merasakan kekuatan seorang pemimpin, itu tidak masalah.

column1: Keep walking forward. One day, you will know the true direction you are heading, and become that irreplaceable beacon.
column2: Terus melangkah maju. Suatu hari kau akan tahu arah sejati yang kau tuju, dan menjadi mercusuar yang tak tergantikan itu.

column1: I wish you smooth sailing on your new journey, Tokarev... 'President'.
column2: Semoga perjalanan barumu lancar, Tokarev... 'Ketua'.
